Petitioners herein seek quashing of FIR No. 0348/2022 dated 04.05.2022, registered at Police Station Hari Nagar, for commission of offences under Sections 498A/34 IPC, along with all consequential proceedings arising therefrom, on the basis of compromise arrived at between the parties.
2. Respondent No.2, however, submits that her statement in the present case be recorded once divorce by way of mutual consent takes place.
